title: A good useful box this month
text:
The September box was really pretty good. I will use and enjoy most of the items in the box which is rare. I love anything from Elemis, the bonus waterless conditioner is perfect for my wigs, spf 50 face cream is always needed, a dark purple eyeliner instead of black is refreshing, been wanting to try something from Wander beauty and everyone needs a mascara, brushes are always welcomed and the sheet mask looks worthwhile even though I don’t really like sheet masks.

Some people hated this box but I guess you can’t please everyone
label: positive
